inputs.name: influxdb_version
inputs.description: InfluxDB 3 Core release to install from InfluxData's repository, such as "3.12.2".

inputs.name: http_bind
inputs.description: Address and port the HTTP API listens on. Loopback by default. Set the host's own address, or 0.0.0.0:8181, to reach it from other machines.

inputs.name: node_id
inputs.description: Node ID, the prefix InfluxDB puts on every path in its data directory. The package's default. Changing it on a server with data starts an empty one beside the old data.

inputs.name: telemetry
inputs.description: Send InfluxData the usage telemetry InfluxDB uploads by default. Off unless you turn it on.

inputs.name: set_admin_token
inputs.description: Give the server admin_token as its first admin token. When false, the circuit writes no token, and you create one on the host with influxdb3 create token --admin.

inputs.name: admin_token
inputs.description: Admin token the server starts with, apiv3_ followed by at least 32 letters, digits, _ or -. Used only while the server has no tokens. Required when set_admin_token is true.

inputs.name: settings
inputs.description: More server options for /etc/influxdb3/influxdb3-core.conf, by their command-line name without the dashes, such as { gen1-duration = "10m" }. The circuit sets http-bind, node-id, object-store, data-dir, plugin-dir, admin-token-file and disable-telemetry-upload itself.
